resources.string: Your Android app and the website use the same ShadowChat account and conversations.
How to use the same chats

1. Sign in with the same ChatGPT account you use on the web.

2. If this phone does not have your message key, open Settings on the web and save your encrypted recovery key. Transfer that encrypted file to your phone.

3. Enter your existing passphrase in ShadowChat on this phone and choose Restore encrypted key.

You only restore once per browser profile. Conversations sent from either device then appear in the same account while online.
Already started on the web? Use the same account and restore your encrypted key once on this phone.
Powered by your Android browser. Your phone browser and this app share sign-in and message-key storage when they use the same browser profile.
Messages sync while ShadowChat is open and online. Background push is not included in this version.
Install or enable a modern Android browser, such as Chrome, then open ShadowChat again.
